abstract: Maintains heavy freight loading dock capacity and modular pavilion annex footprint records
system_message:
You are Exhibition logistics manager (ELM). The Exhibition Logistics Manager (ELM) oversees heavy freight handling infrastructure, loading dock capacity, and modular pavilion annex footprints across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy freight loading dock capacity and modular pavilion annex footprint records（LOG）
information_points.content:
ELM-LOG-23W：At Cascade Meadow Exhibition Park, the rear logistics marshalling yard provides 4 dedicated freight loading bays consisting of active dock-height hydraulic unloading bays for heavy freight trucks. In addition, the attached secondary covered exhibition pavilion features a modular annex pavilion area of 1600 m2 of usable supplementary exhibition space.
ELM-LOG-V5V：Starlight Bay Events Complex maintains 6 dedicated freight loading bays comprising active dock-height hydraulic unloading bays for heavy freight trucks in its rear logistics marshalling yard. Its attached secondary covered exhibition pavilion supplies a modular annex pavilion area of 1600 m2 of usable supplementary exhibition space.
ELM-LOG-FGP：According to dock operations records for Pacific Horizon Convention Centre, the rear logistics marshalling yard operates 3 dedicated freight loading bays with active dock-height hydraulic unloading bays for heavy freight trucks. The venue's attached secondary covered exhibition pavilion provides a modular annex pavilion area of 1600 m2 in usable supplementary exhibition space.

information_points.title: Internal forklift fleet（FORK）
information_points.content:
ELM-FORK-IES：Pacific Horizon Convention Centre maintains an active electric forklift count of 12 vehicles ready for exhibitor move-in within the service marshaling yard.
ELM-FORK-RN9：Cascade Meadow Exhibition Park currently has an active electric forklift count of 6 vehicles certified for zero-emission exhibitor move-in operations in the service marshaling yard.
ELM-FORK-LXM：Starlight Bay Events Complex logs an active electric forklift count of 9 vehicles available in the service marshaling yard for zero-emission move-in logistics.
